dimensions.assessment: Applies to foreign government officials who engage in discriminatory legal, regulatory, or administrative actions against United States persons.
dimensions.evidence: Any alien who, while serving as a government official of any foreign government, initiates, directs, conducts, engages in, or issues one or more investigations... against a United States person... is inadmissible.

dimensions.assessment: Imposes severe immigration penalties, rendering affected foreign officials inadmissible to the United States or deportable.
dimensions.evidence: Any alien who... initiates, directs, conducts, engages in, or issues one or more investigations, enforcement actions, licensing determinations, fines, fees, tax assessments... is deportable.

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending, appropriations, or revenue changes are mentioned in the source material.
Amends sections 212(a)(2) and 237(a)(2) of the Immigration and Nationality Act to add a new category of immigration enforcement grounds.
dimensions.evidence: Section 212(a)(2) of the Immigration and Nationality Act (8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(2)) is amended by adding at the end the following... Economic discrimination

dimensions.assessment: Permanent changes to federal immigration law regarding inadmissible and deportable aliens.

missing_information: Estimated number of foreign officials likely to be affected.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to establish inadmissibility and deportability grounds for foreign government officials who engage in economic discrimination against United States persons.
